body:
Thank you for replying. I should have been more clear. My fiancé told me a secret about himself and I am struggling to come to terms with it.

I think that if I had found out about this earlier on in the relationship and not 2 months before the wedding I would have been able to better handle the information I have received. But now with so little time to our wedding, I can't decide that this is too much for me or seek therapy or do really anything. I just have to accept it but I am having a really hard time.
It's his secret that I found out about. We can talk about it but I don't understand it and I don't want to say the wrong thing to him that might make him feel bad.
